protocol.warmup: W true cycles before SP, then only own predictions
protocol.metric_space: common = our model's train-cell min--max (Ah = common*(HI-LO) + LO)

notes: k-horizon MAEs are prefixes of ONE rollout per run, not separate runs.

Full-span MAE/R2 are labelled with their span length.  Here all three families stop at the same series end, so the spans are 624/524/424 cycles, but they are still not comparable across SPs and are never pooled; only MAE@k is pooled across SPs.
A run whose predicted curve never crosses the threshold contributes no AE; it is counted separately, never imputed.

The trainers' own AE used threshold = rated x 0.7 = 2.1210 Ah; the paper's and the checkpoint's threshold is 2.12 Ah.  Headline numbers use 2.12 Ah for all three families; the sensitivity is reported.
